children: FedEx Freight reported revenue of $2.44 billion in 2026, up 8.1% from the prior-year period, while net income fell 49.5% to $147 million and diluted EPS declined 49.7% to $0.98. Higher fuel surcharges and favorable base yields supported revenue, partly offset by lower shipment volume.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Average daily shipments declined 1% as softer demand weighed on volumes; management expects industrial softness to pressure LTL demand through 2026.
Revenue per shipment rose 10%. Priority shipments increased 1%, while economy shipments declined 4%.
Following its June 2026 spin-off, FedEx Freight is developing independent functions and systems, with transition-related costs increasing.
The company is optimizing its network, strengthening its commercial offering, advancing technology, and pursuing efficiency and cost-to-serve improvements.
